title: Arsenal set to sign England midfielder Georgia Stanway
content:
Arsenal are set to sign England midfielder Georgia Stanway following her Bayern Munich departure.

Stanway, 27, confirmed in January she would be leaving Bayern in the summer upon the expiration of her contract and The Athletic reported Arsenal were leading the race to sign her.

As the midfielder was entering the final six months of her contract, she could sign a pre-contract agreement with a club abroad, which she has now done with Arsenal, and a long-term contract has been agreed.

She still needs to undergo a medical ahead of completing the anticipated move.

Stanway joined Bayern from Manchester City in the summer of 2022 and made 127 appearances for the club, scoring 32 goals and winning four successive Bundesliga titles.

She missed the second half of the 2024-25 season due to a knee ligament injury, but recovered to make England’s 2025 European Championship squad. Stanway played an important role as Sarina Wiegman’s side defended their title in Switzerland, starting all six matches at the tournament and scoring twice.

The move would see Stanway join England internationals Leah Williamson, Lotte Wubben-Moy, Chloe Kelly, Alessia Russo, Taylor Hinds and Michelle Agyemang in the Arsenal squad.

The north London side have already confirmed fellow Lioness Beth Mead will depart the club at the end of the season, with Manchester City pursuing a deal for the winger, while the exits of Katie McCabe, Laia Codina and Victoria Pelova have also been announced. The Athletic reported in January the club were in talks to sign Ona Batlle from Barcelona in the summer.

Arsenal finished second in the Women’s Super League this season and reached the Champions League semi-finals.
